storage.immutability: source run, document, and bundle artifacts are never overwritten; index and latest are rebuildable derived views
storage.writerAuthority: writer-context-v1 must reference an immutable bundle gzip; latest is never authoritative writer input
storage.p1gaArtifacts: P1-GA creates no index, latest view, production bundle, or gzip data artifact

rules: itemCount is an integer greater than or equal to zero
ready, partial, and stale require a lowercase 64-character SHA-256 rawSnapshotId and stored or hash_only snapshotPolicy
unavailable, rate_limited, and schema_changed require rawSnapshotId null, snapshotPolicy none, coverage.itemCount 0, and at least one warning
requestedAt is a timezone-bearing ISO-8601 audit timestamp and is excluded from business identity
asOf is a timezone-bearing ISO-8601 timestamp or null and must never be fabricated from the current time

sourceRunId is lowercase 64-character SHA-256 of canonical sourceId, provider, sourceClass, asOf, status, sourceUrl, sorted unique marketScopes, sorted unique topics, fixed-key-order coverage, snapshotPolicy, and rawSnapshotId
integrity.businessSha256 equals sourceRunId; integrity.sha256 hashes the complete canonical source run excluding integrity.sha256 itself
same sourceRunId with identical complete content is idempotent; different complete content fails closed
sourceRunId references exactly one source run in the bundle and sourceId exactly equals that run's sourceId
sourceClass is resolved from sourceRunId and is never copied or overridden by a document
publisherId is a stable lowercase ASCII slug matching ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{1,79}$; publisher is display-only
canonicalUrl uses a URL parser: https scheme and hostname are lowercase, fragment and default port 443 are removed, an empty path becomes /, and business-semantic path/query is preserved
canonicalUrl is not a Google, Bing, or other search-results URL; source-specific query cleanup is deferred to P1-GB
contentSha256 and rawSnapshotId are lowercase 64-character SHA-256 values; ordinary HTTP responses hash entity bytes after HTTP content decoding and before character decoding or body parsing
pdf-metadata hashes normalized public metadata only when PDF body download is prohibited and records metadata-only in warning or locator
publishedAt may be null but accessedAt must not be substituted for it
metadata and bounded evidence excerpts only; full text, HTML, base64, and binary content are prohibited

documentId is SHA-256 of canonical sourceRunId, canonicalUrl, publishedAt, and contentSha256; integrity.businessSha256 equals documentId; integrity.sha256 hashes the complete canonical document excluding integrity.sha256 itself
window contains start, end, and Asia/Shanghai timezone; end equals asOf and start is not later than end
sourceRuns sort by sourceRunId; documents, observations, events, and duplicateClusters sort by their identity field
observations have at least one supports basis, reference existing documents, have nonempty marketScopes and topics, and do not add probability, ranking, or investment advice
observation asOf is YYYY-MM-DD and is not later than bundle asOf; observation occurredAt is a timezone-bearing ISO-8601 timestamp or null
non-calendar observation occurredAt is not later than Asia/Shanghai 23:59:59 of bundle asOf; calendar-event may be later only when an already-published support document announces the future calendar
events only organize existing observations and add no new facts, probability, forecast, or importance score
duplicate cluster members exist, number at least two, include canonicalDocumentId, and a document belongs to at most one cluster
exact-url clusters require equal canonicalUrl; content-hash clusters require equal contentSha256; publisher-reprint and semantic-signature retain every source audit record
duplicate method precedence is exact-url, content-hash, publisher-reprint, semantic-signature; a document in at most one cluster uses the highest provable method
canonical duplicate document is earliest publishedAt, then smallest documentId; null publishedAt sorts after valid times
daily and weekly coverage has exactly one each of A_SHARE, HK, US, FED and zero or one GLOBAL, sorted by market enum; topics are unique, enum-sorted, and include every observed topic
market and topic counts are unique documents or observations whose corresponding scope array contains that market or topic; overlapping categories must not be summed against top-level array lengths

coverage totals equal array lengths and conflictingObservations counts observations with evidenceState conflicting; unavailable and partial require reasons, ready requires an empty reasons array; zero is an actual count rather than availability

bundleId is SHA-256 of recursive business view: schemaVersion, edition, asOf, window, sourcePolicyVersion, sorted sourceRunIds, sorted documentIds, observation/event/duplicate-cluster business views, and coverage

integrity.businessSha256 equals bundleId; integrity.sha256 hashes the complete canonical bundle excluding integrity.sha256 itself; the same bundleId with different integrity.sha256 fails closed; generatedAt is audit time and is excluded from bundle identity
stored is only for permitted official structured or publicly redistributable material
hash_only is the default for media, community, social, and copyright-unclear pages
none is required for unavailable, rate_limited, schema_changed, or explicitly prohibited sources

identity.hash: SHA-256 of canonicalized business content using deterministic ordering

sortBeforeHash: basis by documentId, relation, locator, excerpt
observation.entity: nonempty string with at most 120 characters

identity.conflictBehavior: same identity and same content is idempotent; same identity and different content fails closed

precedence: without contradicts, a supports document whose source run class is official-primary, company-filing, exchange-market-data, or primary-research produces confirmed
without an authoritative primary source, at least two eligible independent publisherId values produce corroborated
supports solely from community-signal or social-signal produce unverified
all other single-publisher support produces single-source
constraints: only major-media, specialist-media, vendor-market-data, and vendor-estimate documents are eligible corroborating publishers
publisherId, not display publisher, defines independence; the same publisherId counts once
documents in one duplicate cluster collectively contribute at most one publisher; publisher-reprint and semantic-signature do not add independent support
community-signal and social-signal never participate in corroborated counting or produce confirmed/corroborated
confirmed means direct support by authoritative primary material, not certainty about a future, causal, or inferential claim
analysis-context is confirmed only when its statement accurately describes the source analysis or method, never as proof of market causality
AI must not assign an evidenceState inconsistent with this derivation

hashOnlyRetains: response status and collection audit metadata
noneRequired: robots or site terms prohibit collection
source explicitly prohibited from collection or storage
sourcePolicy.policyBlockedStatus: unavailable with a warning that collection is policy-prohibited, never schema_changed
prohibited: bulk retention of news full text
media image, video, or PDF binary download or embedding

writerContextBoundary.p1fTransition: writer-request-v1 will be upgraded or replaced in P1-H; P1-GA does not modify P1-F code
